title: I Used the Bike-Room Camera on the Neighbor Who Took My Labeled Helmet

parts.text: I pulled the still at 7:21 p.m. with my labeled helmet on neighbor Odin's hook. The sign said LABELS STAY WITH THE HOOK. I was thirty-six, tenant, standing in a cage that made me look like I owned the visor. Odin said helmets were atmosphere. I photographed the label, the hook, and Odin's bike under my lid. Then I let the camera keep the timestamp. Odin laughed until the super asked for the still. The helmet came back. Odin label-dates the hook now. A cage is only a cage until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The bike-room camera had my helmet on his hook — Part 1/1
social.description: Labeled lid, wrong hook, a super still. Has a cage ever loaned your visor?
